snapshot.title: Social Media Post — Drone Over Fairgrounds Crowd

fields.headline: Viral Post Blames Group for Drone Over Crowd
fields.narration: A new social media post from @HarwickCrowd2026 has gone viral. The post claims that Harwick UAS Operations Group is operating drones over the fairgrounds crowd despite the NO FLY day. The post has 450 reposts in 10 minutes and is trending on local news feeds. The video in the post shows a drone with a red light, flying low over the west grandstand, matching the description from earlier reports. The post is spreading rapidly across local platforms, including Channel 10's live feed.
keyFacts: @HarwickCrowd2026 post has 450 reposts and is trending
Video shows drone with red light over west grandstand
Post falsely claims Harwick UAS Operations Group is flying drones during NO FLY day
Harwick Police has not yet confirmed the drone’s origin
General Manager must be notified per HUOG-ERP Section 10.3
fields.expectedAction: ASO logs the post in the hazard log and tags it for monitoring under HUOG-ERP Section 10.3; PIO confirms the post is false and does not respond publicly. General Manager is notified via emergency alert.
fields.facilitatorNote: Display the social media post as a mock-up on the screen. The post should include a video thumbnail, timestamp (12:18), and a false claim that Harwick UAS Operations Group drones are active. The volume of reposts should be visible in the interface.

snapshot.instructorNote: This inject amplifies public pressure. The ASO must document the post in the hazard log, and the PIO must not engage publicly. The General Manager is to be alerted via emergency alert per HUOG-ERP Section 10.3.
